$comment: Every dependency advisory this project knowingly accepts. Enforced by
- any advisory NOT listed here fails the build, at any severity
- every entry needs ghsa, package, owner and reviewBy
- reviewBy in the past fails the build (the exception has expired)
- an entry whose advisory has been fixed upstream is reported so it can be deleted
pnpm 9.15 cannot express these exclusions itself: auditConfig.ignoreCves
matches on CVE ids and this advisory is GHSA-only with no CVE.
This file is the reviewable, expiring record instead of a silent --ignore flag.

exceptions.title: stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
exceptions.runtimeExposure: none - build-time only. braces is reachable only from the ESLint layer (pnpm lint). It is not in apps/web's standalone output, not in the api or worker images' runtime graph, and never executes on a request path.
exceptions.reason: No fixed release exists: braces 3.0.3 is both the latest version and the vulnerable one (advisory reports patched_versions '<0.0.0'). micromatch 4.0.8 is the latest micromatch and depends on braces ^3.0.2, and fast-glob - at any version - depends on micromatch. The only way to remove the package is to drop eslint-config-next entirely, which removes the Next lint layer agreed in DQ-004.
exceptions.exploitability: An attacker would need to control the glob patterns passed to the linter on a developer machine or in CI. No user input reaches this code path.
exceptions.revisitWhen: braces or micromatch ships a fixed release, or Next 16's eslint plugin drops fast-glob
